short: An English first-rate ship of the line, renowned for her immense size and heavy armament.
full:
Commissioned by King Charles I, the Sovereign of the Seas was launched in 1637 as a prestigious statement of naval supremacy. Financed controversially by Ship Money, she was the first ship designed to carry over a hundred guns. Her immense size and elaborate gilded ornamentation earned her the nickname "Golden Devil" among her enemies.

She saw extensive service during the Anglo-Dutch Wars, consistently proving to be a formidable floating fortress that anchored the English line of battle. She remained one of the most powerful warships in the world for over half a century, until she was accidentally destroyed by fire at Chatham in 1696.
